en: Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a carved stone figure, likely medieval, showing a man kneeling on one knee while supporting a broken vertical architectural element (possibly a column or pilaster) on his shoulder. He wears a cap and a tunic with puffed sleeves, has a stern facial expression, and stands on a textured base. The background is plain studio gray, suggesting a museum object photograph. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
